Like other sections of this book, it expounds spiritual qualities through the metaphorical attributes of a specific subject—here, the traits and conduct of a universal monarch (*cakkavatti*) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records thematic associations or mentions between this discourse and Dhammapada verse 350, the Chinese *Dharmapada* translation (T 210.32, 愛欲品法句經), and the *Nagaropamasutta* (AN 7.67) [SuttaCentral].
